title: Series on Shannon Stirnweis
content: At the blog "Today's Inspiration," illustration historian Leif Peng is doing a series of posts interviewingShannon Stirnweis(b. 1931) about his years painting pictures for the advertising, men's adventure, western, and romance markets.Shannon Stirnweis, Part 1: "I wanted to be an artist when I grew up"Shannon Stirnweis, Part 2: "The (men's) adventure begins"
